bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
out="$(mktemp)"
trap 'rm -f "$out"' EXIT
{
 echo '## 2026-11-15 Menu hotfix preflight'
 echo "GayBBS_Status=$(docker inspect -f '{{.State.Status}}' deploy-gaybbs-1)"
 echo "GayBBS_Image=$(docker inspect -f '{{.Image}}' deploy-gaybbs-1)"
 echo "Creator_Status=$(docker inspect -f '{{.State.Status}}' gace-createvdobot-videobot-poll-1)"
 echo 'GateCodes:'
 docker exec deploy-postgres-1 psql -X -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -U gace -d gaybbs -Atc "SELECT chat_id||':'||(gate_code IS NOT NULL AND length(gate_code) BETWEEN 1 AND 48) FROM targets WHERE target_type='entry_group' AND chat_id IN (-1003847210571,-1002373696859,-1003770334893) ORDER BY chat_id;"
 echo 'LinkMenuStates:'
 docker exec deploy-postgres-1 psql -X -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -U gace -d gaybbs -Atc "SELECT chat_id||':'||state FROM board_menu_panels WHERE panel_type='posting' ORDER BY chat_id;"
 echo "Userbot=$(systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service || true)"
} > "$out"
gh issue comment 56 --repo seigo-gace/GateApp-Bot --body-file "$out" >/dev/null
echo PREFLIGHT_PUBLISHED=PASS
